about_the_game:
Give your Sims a serene, modern bathroom featuring minimalist design and refined details with The Sims 4 Sleek Bathroom kit*. This collection brings a soothing vibe with a sophisticated aesthetic. The combination of clean lines and natural materials strikes a harmonious balance between warmth and elegance. Soft pastel tones blend effortlessly with brushed metal accents, while touches of greenery breathe life into the space, transforming any bathroom into a polished sanctuary. Created by Syboulette.

KEY FEATURES
  • Refined Plumbing — Let's bring a balance of style and comfort. A custom glass divider adds style to the walk-in shower, while a simple bathtub creates a high-end feel. The toilet features a streamlined design, paired with a wall-mounted ceramic sink accented with wood. Thoughtful details like towels, clutter, and a draping plant add warmth, while an olive tree and wavy mirrors soften the clean lines, bringing life and flow to the space.
